answer: Hardware enclave attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to sign challenges from an unpredictable randomness beacon using secure physical chips. Because identities cannot be virtualized, an attacker must procure discrete hardware modules bound to physical copper traces, incurring a linear manufacturing cost per spawned node. However, this reliance creates supply-chain centralization and risks turning compromised silicon into an undetectable haven for rogue agents.
